name: CYBERPUNK
style: a cyberpunk anime film still at night: neon signs, rain-soaked reflective streets, holographic billboards and haze; people restyled as cyberpunk characters in techwear with subtle chrome implants.

variants.neon: Use magenta and cyan neon light.
variants.volt: Use electric yellow and cyan neon light.
variants.blade: Use orange smog and teal neon light.
variants.ghost: Use icy blue and violet neon light.
